pages.text: $(bold)Dragonsteel Ice$() (default trait of Dragonsteel Ice)$(br2)Effect: $(bold)on hit$(), applies a frost effect that $(bold)greatly slows$() the target, dealing continuous frostbite damage and spreading frost around it.$(br2)Dragonsteel Ice is a strong control trait — combined with ice-element builds, it can keep targets frozen for a long time.
